enabled: Enable natural ocean growth on the server.
shiftPlantingStartsNewColony: Holding Shift while planting starts a new colony, even inside another colony's radius.
coral: Settings for living coral propagation and reef growth.
seagrass: Settings for seagrass propagation. New plants have an equal chance of being short or tall.
kelp: Settings for horizontal kelp propagation. Vanilla controls vertical growth within the height policy.
Enable natural propagation for this species.
coral.growthChance / seagrass.growthChan: Chance per eligible growth attempt, from 0 to 1. This is not a chance per server tick.
coral.maxColonyRadius / seagrass.maxColo: Maximum horizontal distance from the inherited colony origin, in blocks (1-24). Descendants keep the same origin.
coral.maxDensity / seagrass.maxDensity /: Local crowding limit in a 3-by-3 neighborhood, greater than 0 and at most 1.
coral.maxAreaDensity / seagrass.maxAreaD: Species occupancy limit per 16-by-16 habitat area, greater than 0 and at most 1. Existing excess vegetation is not removed.
maxOperationsPerTick: Shared server-wide ecology work budget per tick (1-4096). A low budget can delay chunk cycles.
maxOperationsPerChunk: Maximum ecology work budget for one chunk cycle (1-4096), also limited by the shared budget.
attemptsPerChunk: Growth sampling attempts per eligible chunk cycle (1-4).
intervalTicks: Requested interval between each chunk's cycles (1-72000 ticks). Budget pressure can delay a cycle; no offline catch-up occurs.
maxDistance: Maximum horizontal distance of one propagation step, in blocks (1-4).
maxTerrainStep: Maximum seabed rise or descent between consecutive path samples, in blocks (0-4).
playerChunkRadius: Maximum chunk distance from each player (0-32), limited by actual view distance, simulation distance and loaded ticking chunks.
minimumLight: Minimum brightness at a growth destination (0-15).
reefGrowthEnabled: Allow mature coral habitats to build solid reefs gradually using vanilla-generated plans.
allowReefsOutsideWarmOcean: Allow reef growth in other eligible ocean biomes. When false, the reefs_allowed biome tag restricts growth, normally to warm ocean.
reefMaturityThreshold: Fraction of the configured coral habitat capacity required before reef construction starts (0-1).
kelpHeights: Random natural kelp height limits. Existing taller kelp is never trimmed.
kelpHeights.enabled: Assign persistent random height ceilings to natural kelp and its descendants.
kelpHeights.minimumHeight: Minimum random kelp height ceiling, in blocks (1-384), limited by available water.
kelpHeights.maximumHeight: Maximum random kelp height ceiling, in blocks (0-384). Zero uses the available ocean height; otherwise must be at least minimumHeight.
kelpHeights.maxInitializationsPerTick: Maximum new kelp height ceilings initialized per server tick (1-64).
kelpHeights.bonemealBypassesLimit: Allow bonemeal to grow kelp beyond its natural height ceiling.
kelpHeights.playerStackingBypassesLimit: Allow players to stack kelp above its natural height ceiling. Vanilla placement rules still apply.
